status: PROPOSED — not written to the install, not added to PAGE_SEO
why: Three pages were converted on 2026-09-02 (contact, privacy-policy, terms). None was in the round Empower approved on 2026-08-21, so all three have an empty wp_aioseo_posts row and AIOSEO generates their description at request time from post_content. On /contact/ that means the meta description and the schema still advertise the superseded street address, because post_content is still the Beaver fallback. These drafts replace that.

targets.title: 45-60 characters INCLUDING the 22-character ' - Empower Mississippi' suffix
targets.description: 140-160 characters, first ~110 standing alone because that is all a phone shows
targets.sourcing: Written from each page's own copy. Nothing invented, no figure that is not on the page.

pages.title: Contact Us: Send Us a Message
pages.description: Send Empower Mississippi a message using the form on this page. We’d love to hear from you. Write to us at 741 Avignon Dr., Suite C, Ridgeland, MS.
pages.sourcedFrom: The page's own heading and lead sentence ('We’d love to hear from you! Use the form below to e-mail us.') and the address block.
pages.note: THE ADDRESS IS THE OPEN QUESTION. This uses 741 Avignon Dr., Suite C, which is what the signed-off footer carries on every page. The page this replaced said 1000 Northpark Dr. If Empower confirm Northpark is current, this description and the page both change together.

pages.title: Privacy Policy and Your Data Choices

pages.sourcedFrom: The policy's own first paragraph ('It is our policy not to sell, rent, lease or otherwise distribute that information to anyone'), its opt-out paragraph, and its 'About the Text Message Services and Opting Out' section.

pages.title: Terms of Service for Our Website
